from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/160-6/1_160-6_input.xlsx")

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["SH"]

# Only the allowed answer range may be modified.
start_row, end_row = 6, 11
start_col, end_col = 1, 12  # A:L

# Build the compacted dataset by removing fully blank rows, preserving row order.
# Header is assumed to be row 1, so data starts at row 2.
non_blank_rows = []
for r in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    row_values = [ws.cell(r, c).value for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1)]
    if any(v is not None and str(v).strip() != "" for v in row_values):
        non_blank_rows.append(row_values)

# After blank-row deletion, Excel row 2 contains the first data row.
# Therefore row N should contain non_blank_rows[N - 2].
for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    data_index = r - 2
    values = non_blank_rows[data_index] if data_index < len(non_blank_rows) else [None] * (end_col - start_col + 1)
    for offset, c in enumerate(range(start_col, end_col + 1)):
        ws.cell(r, c).value = values[offset]

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
